entries.Event.cs.1260: Завршио сам књигу! $h#$b#Па, ево је... '%book'. Говори о државном геодети који посећује сићушну, изоловану рударску заједницу... и открива узнемирујуће тајне.$u#$b#-Скоро- да мислим да треба да поделим зараду с тобом, с обзиром на сву твоју помоћ!$h

contextNotes.AdoptPet: Use nominative pet-type label in parentheses, allowing arbitrary localized pet type without grammatical case agreement.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1257: Elliott explicitly authored the book; masculine self-reference. Preserve %book, emotion tokens, #$b# paragraphs and -almost- emphasis.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1258: Elliott's romance premise retains train stewardess, traveling architect and his secret engagement to the ticket collector's daughter; preserve asterisk emphasis and $l.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1308: Only the original ^ branch is gendered; all shared text stays gender-independent. Preserve farm name %farm without inflecting user text.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1309: Grandpa is male; common-body past reference умео refers to Grandpa, not the player. Retain original single ^ and every #$b# break.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1497: A child can be Jas or Vincent; neutral first-person aorist and during-play phrasing avoid assigning an unverified gender.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1521: Preserve exact $q/$r headers, IDs, yes/no branch keys and every # delimiter. Only the prompt and response text are localized.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1535: Apply glossary meaning's established изложба пољопривредних производа for Grange Display throughout.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1633: Use gender-independent shared invitation/acceptance wording; flower-dance event name is the mandatory Плес цвећа.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1659: Use glossary Star Token=Звездани жетон across every singular/plural festival currency reference. All g suffixes and numerical amounts remain source exact.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1723: Keep placement ordinal and all point/token values. Recipients of first through fourth place are addressed without inferred player gender.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1736: Keep danceAsk and null technical branch IDs exactly; recipient name {0} follows a colon as uninflected label.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1740: Gift recipient is an uninflected proper-name label; male/female source prompt variants have the same natural Serbian wording.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1761: Shane explicitly speaks about himself and Jas in his existing crisis scene; masculine person and emotion/hiccup markers are retained.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1788: Recipient {0} stays uninflected in a separate label, preserving the gift-selection action.
contextNotes.Event.cs.1504: Installed Event.setUpSecretSantaCommands calls LoadStringByGender on the arbitrary gift-giver. Use a gender-neutral budget sentence; do not assume male speaker.
